scope: one controlled spot check: 5 min screen-on idle baseline, then 10 min with one 50-prompt on-device model run

measurements.battery_level: 100% at start and end; charge counter used for resolution

workload.duration_note: the model run took roughly 4.5 minutes; the remaining window was idle with the screen on

limitations: Battery started at 100%, so percentage drain is useless; charge-counter mAh is the only signal
No controlled ambient temperature or cooling; one spot check, not a battery-life estimate
Screen stayed on in both phases and Do Not Disturb was not guaranteed
System charge counter, not an external power meter
The workload window includes idle tail after the model run
